2016 Audi SQ5 3.0T quattro Premium Plus

Glacier White Metallic | Black Fine Nappa Leather | 3.0L Supercharged V6 | Automatic | quattro AWD | 139,625 Miles | 1-Owner | Original MSRP $61,830

The 2016 Audi SQ5 3.0T quattro Premium Plus combines the practicality of Audi's Q5 platform with the performance and chassis tuning expected from an S model. Finished in Glacier White Metallic over Black Fine Nappa Leather, this example is powered by Audi's proven 3.0-liter supercharged V6 paired with an automatic transmission and quattro full-time all-wheel drive.

Showing 139,625 miles, this SQ5 is a CARFAX 1-owner personal vehicle that has remained in Texas since new. It was originally sold by Audi Grapevine and has an unusually extensive documented dealer maintenance history, with the CARFAX identifying it as a Homegrown vehicle meaning it was originally sold there and at least 75% of its reported service was also performed there.

This SQ5 was also well-optioned from the factory, carrying an original MSRP of $61,830.

Factory Equipment & Options

  • 3.0L Supercharged V6

  • Automatic Transmission

  • quattro Full-Time All-Wheel Drive

  • Glacier White Metallic

  • Original MSRP of $61,830

Service History

One of the strongest attributes of this SQ5 is its long-term Audi dealer maintenance history. The vehicle was originally sold by Audi Grapevine and continued returning there for service throughout its life.

Early maintenance includes the factory 5,000-, 15,000-, 25,000- and 35,000-mile services, along with regular maintenance inspections, alignments, tire rotations and other scheduled services.

At 41,741 miles, Audi Grapevine performed the 35,000-mile service along with an extensive round of maintenance that included:

  • Water Pump Replacement

  • Water Pump Gasket Replacement

  • Antifreeze/Coolant Flush

  • Brake Fluid Flush

  • Cooling System Inspection

  • Brake Inspection

  • Drivability/Performance Check

  • Tire Rotation & Balancing

At 54,145 miles, another substantial Audi dealer service was completed, including the 55,000-mile service and:

  • Engine Mount Replacement

  • Rear Brake Pads Replacement

  • Rear Brake Rotors Replacement

  • Serpentine Belt Replacement

  • Front Wiper Blade Replacement

At 65,589 miles, the SQ5 received its 65,000-mile service, including an oil and filter change, coolant flush, fuel system service, four-wheel alignment, tire rotation and balancing.

At 84,613 miles, Audi Grapevine performed the 85,000-mile service, including an oil and filter change, brake fluid flush, and replacement of both the front and rear brake calipers.

At 94,255 miles, another significant round of maintenance included:

  • Engine Timing/Front Cover Gasket Replacement

  • Antifreeze/Coolant Flush

  • Oil & Filter Change

  • Brake Inspection

  • Two Tires Replaced

At 103,900 miles, the front brake pads and rotors were replaced, along with another oil and filter change. Additional oil service was documented at 111,107 miles.

More recently, Audi Grapevine continued servicing the vehicle. An oil and filter change was completed at 121,973 miles. At 126,036 miles, the water pump and water pump gasket were replaced again and the coolant was flushed. Another oil and filter change was performed at 131,920 miles.

Most recently, at 137,429 miles, Audi Grapevine performed a maintenance inspection along with:

  • Oil & Filter Change

  • Antifreeze/Coolant Flush

  • Brake Fluid Flush

  • Cabin Air Filter Replacement

  • Tire Rotation

  • Keyless Remote Battery Replacement

The vehicle then returned to Audi Grapevine for another maintenance inspection at 139,595 miles, just 30 miles before its current 139,625-mile odometer reading.

It delivers considerably more performance and character than a conventional luxury crossover while retaining the comfort and practicality needed for everyday use.

What particularly stands out about this example is its ownership and maintenance history. With one personal owner since new, extensive servicing through the same Audi dealership that originally sold the vehicle, and several significant maintenance items already documented including water pumps, engine mounts, timing/front cover gasket work, brakes, calipers, and regular fluid services this 139,625-mile SQ5 presents an appealing opportunity for an enthusiast looking for a well-optioned and extensively maintained example of Audi's supercharged performance SUV.

If you've been searching for a capable, no-nonsense off-roader, this 2016 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport for sale at Turbo Motors in Taylor, Michigan is exactly what you've been looking for. With its iconic body-on-frame build, four-wheel drive, and a six-speed manual transmission, this Wrangler is built for buyers who want a real truck — not a crossover pretending to be one. Stock #3335TM is on the lot now and ready for a test drive.About This 2016 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport At 131,590 miles, this Wrangler is well into its working life — and that's perfectly normal for a model known for going the distance. Wranglers are built to be driven hard, and the Unlimited's longer wheelbase four-door body means you get the legendary Jeep capability paired with rear seating and daily-driver practicality. The Unlimited Sport is the entry point into the Wrangler family, which means it's clean and functional without unnecessary complexity — a huge plus when it comes to long-term maintenance and repair costs.

The Sport trim keeps things simple: solid axles front and rear, Command-Trac part-time 4WD, and a straightforward interior that's easy to live with. These trucks were built to be worked on, and parts are widely available across the metro Detroit area and beyond.2016 Jeep Wrangler Performance and Engine Under the hood sits Jeep's 3.6-liter Pentastar V6, one of the most proven engines in the FCA lineup. It produces around 285 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque, giving the Wrangler more than enough grunt to handle trails, towing light loads, and highway miles alike. Paired with the six-speed manual transmission, this is the driver's choice — you stay in control of every shift, which matters when you're picking your way through technical terrain or navigating icy Michigan backroads in winter.

The Command-Trac 4WD system gives you 2H for everyday driving, 4H for slippery roads and mild trails, and 4L for when things get serious. With a solid front axle and available skid plate protection, this Wrangler is built to handle what southeastern Michigan winters and weekend trail runs can throw at it.Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport Features and Interior The Sport trim is Jeep's foundation-level Wrangler, which means the interior is clean, durable, and honest. You'll typically find cloth seating, a straightforward center console, power windows and locks, and a no-nonsense instrument cluster. The Unlimited four-door body adds rear legroom and a fold-flat rear seat that dramatically expands cargo space when you need it.

One of the best things about the Wrangler Unlimited Sport is what it doesn't have — layers of electronics and driver-assist systems that can be expensive to fix. The simplicity of the Sport trim makes it easier and cheaper to maintain, which is a major reason buyers continue to seek out this exact configuration years after purchase.Jeep Wrangler Reliability and Ownership The Wrangler's reputation for durability is well-earned. The 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 is widely regarded as one of Chrysler's best engines, and with proper oil change intervals and cooling system maintenance, these motors routinely push past 200,000 miles. The six-speed manual transmission is also considered more reliable than the automatic option in many owner communities — fewer components, fewer failure points.

Common things to check on a Wrangler at this mileage include the front axle U-joints, transfer case fluid, and the freedom top or soft top seals if equipped. Rust is always a consideration on Michigan vehicles — it's worth a look at the rocker panels and floor pans during your inspection. Overall, the Wrangler is one of the most parts-accessible, mechanic-friendly vehicles on the road, and local shops across Wayne County are very familiar with them.Why Buy From Turbo Motors? Turbo Motors is a locally operated dealership serving buyers throughout Taylor and the greater Wayne County area. Land Rover Riverside is delighted to showcase, this Pre-Owned 2016 INFINITI QX70 Dressed in an elegant Liquid Platinum exterior with a sophisticated Graphite interior and with 110,117 miles to its name, this vehicle delivers a compelling blend of distinctive styling, luxury, and engaging performance.
The QX70 commands attention with its athletic proportions, sculpted bodywork, and bold INFINITI design language. Its 18-inch 5-spoke aluminum-alloy wheels with 265/60R18 all-season tires complement its confident stance, while High Intensity Discharge (HID) bi-functional xenon headlights and LED daytime running lights provide striking illumination. Front fog lights, a power sliding tinted glass moonroof with one-touch open/close, and a power rear liftgate further enhance its combination of style and everyday versatility.

Step inside and the Graphite interior greets you with an inviting blend of comfort, craftsmanship, and thoughtful technology. Leather-appointed seating, heated 10-way power driver's seat including 2-way power lumbar support, heated 8-way power passenger seat, dual-zone automatic temperature control, and power folding and heated outside mirrors help create a refined driving environment. The RearView Monitor, 7-inch color vehicle information display, Bluetooth Hands-Free Phone System, and Bose 11-speaker Premium Sound System provide convenience and entertainment for every journey.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this 2016 INFINITI QX70 is a responsive 3.7-liter V6 engine producing 325 horsepower and 267 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a 7-speed automatic transmission with Adaptive Shift Control (ASC) and manual shift mode with Downshift Rev Matching, the QX70 delivers smooth, confident acceleration. Rear-wheel drive, independent front and multi-link rear suspension, and front and rear stabilizer bars contribute to the engaging road manners for which the QX70 is known.

Key Features:

• Bose Premium Sound System: An 11-speaker premium audio system designed to deliver rich, immersive sound throughout the cabin.

• Power Sliding Moonroof: A tinted glass moonroof with one-touch open and close functionality brings additional light and fresh air into the cabin.

• Heated Leather-Appointed Seating: Luxurious leather-appointed seats with heated front seating provide comfort and refinement for driver and passenger alike.

• RearView Monitor: Provides added visibility and convenience when maneuvering the vehicle in reverse.

• Bluetooth Hands-Free Phone System: Allows compatible phone connectivity for convenient hands-free communication while on the road.

• High Intensity Discharge Xenon Headlights: Bi-functional xenon headlights with LED daytime running lights provide distinctive styling and enhanced nighttime illumination.

This 2016 INFINITI QX70 is far more than just an SUV, it is a distinctive combination of performance, luxury, and expressive design. Available at Land Rover Riverside, this vehicle offers an invitation to experience the comfort, capability, and engaging character that make the QX70 such a unique luxury crossover.

Our dealership features a beautiful Land Rover Corporate Identity showroom, fully staffed factory certified service center, parts department, finance department, detail department, and Land Rover accessories boutique. Allow us to also help arrange transportation of your new car directly to your home anywhere in the world. Trade-in proposals are always welcome. 2020 Jeep Compass Latitude 4x4: The Adventurous Compact SUV
The 2020 Jeep Compass Latitude 4x4 is a stellar choice in the compact SUV market, brilliantly merging iconic Jeep capability, everyday comfort, and modern style. Designed to handle both daily urban commutes and weekend trail excursions with total confidence, this well-rounded crossover delivers an engaging and versatile driving experience. For anyone seeking a practical, stylish, and adventure-ready vehicle, the Compass Latitude stands out as an exceptional daily driver.

Confident 4x4 Capability and Performance
Under the hood, the Compass is powered by a reliable 2.4-liter Tigershark 4-cylinder engine generating a robust 180 horsepower and 175 lb-ft of torque, paired with a smooth-shifting automatic transmission. This setup provides eager acceleration for highway passing and city driving alike. Equipped with Jeep's legendary Active Drive 4x4 system and the intuitive Selec-Terrain traction management system, the vehicle instantly adapts to changing road conditions. Whether navigating torrential downpours, slick snow-covered streets, or unpaved dirt roads, it delivers supreme grip and peace of mind.

The Latitude Advantage: Comfort and Connected Tech
The Latitude trim elevates the cabin experience, packing a wealth of smart features and creature comforts designed to make every journey effortless:

Refined Interior: Features premium cloth and vinyl combination bucket seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and tasteful metallic-tone accents throughout the cabin.

Intuitive Infotainment: Equipped with a user-friendly 7-inch touchscreen featuring Uconnect, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth streaming, and voice-activated controls.

Everyday Convenience: Includes dual-zone automatic climate control, a convenient rear-view backup camera, ambient interior lighting, and keyless entry with push-button start.

Striking Exterior Style: Sports bold athletic lines, signature trapezoidal wheel arches, automatic halogen headlamps, fog lamps, bright chrome window moldings, and gleaming 17-inch silver-painted aluminum wheels.

Clever Passenger and Cargo Versatility
Inside, the cabin makes brilliant use of its footprint. It offers generous headroom and supportive legroom for up to five passengers, ensuring everyone stays comfortable on long road trips. When cargo duty calls, the 60/40 split-folding rear seats fold completely flat, opening up a spacious cargo area capable of securely hauling luggage, camping gear, sports equipment, or shopping hauls with ease.

Final Verdict
The 2020 Jeep Compass Latitude 4x4 is a phenomenal compact SUV that excels across every category. By combining legendary four-wheel-drive performance, a comfortable and tech-savvy cabin, striking styling, and everyday practicality, it delivers a deeply rewarding ownership experience.
